method.timed: winner replacement only; input/table/index setup, validation, GC, IPC and process startup excluded
method.storage: identical TEMP event rows, temp_store=FILE, 4MiB main/temp page caches; no permanent writes or aggregate queries
method.memory: separate selection after GC; before/after heap is not a transient peak; process high-water RSS includes setup and warmups
method.distribution: ordinal-v1, 14 provider/session files, 10 repeats per duplicate group; missing/single/ambiguous Claude request IDs; no request/response bodies
method.correctness: hand-specified winning ordinal and canonical request plus unchanged source-row fields; correction, unsafe score sum, sentinel, provider/session, root and latest tie boundaries
